title: Erythroderma / Sezary Syndrome Workup
subtitle: Distinguish inflammatory erythroderma from leukemic CTCL

steps.prompt: Erythroderma with pruritus, lymphadenopathy, palmoplantar keratoderma, or alopecia?
Obtain CBC differential, flow cytometry, TCR studies, LDH, skin biopsies, and node assessment
Known MF with erythroderma or skin-limited clonal disease?
Repeat clinicopathologic correlation and monitor blood

citations.quote: Olsen EA et al. ISCL/EORTC staging and classification proposal for MF/SS. Blood. 2007.
EORTC 2023 consensus update provides current treatment standards for mycosis fungoides and Sezary syndrome.
